relationships.subject: ropivacaine
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results showed that RBBP4 protein expression levels were significantly downregulated in a contraction-related manner in the ropivacaine-treated group compared to the control group (Fig. 4A)

relationships.subject: RBBP4
relationships.evidence_quote: The MTS assay results showed that RBBP4 knockdown by siRNAs led to a significant decrease in the proliferation of A549 and H1299 cells

key_findings: Ropivacaine suppresses lung cancer cell malignancy by downregulating RBBP4; RBBP4 overexpression reverses the effect.
